name: Itazura Real
original_name: 悪戯極～いたずらリアル～
source:
Shunsuke is a white-collar worker. One day, he is mistakenly arrested for on-train molestation. He denies it, but no one around him proves his innocence, especially three girls. They tell the police that he is the culprit. As a result, he is arrested and gets fired.... Several days later, he finds the girls on the train by chance. He gets mad and decides to take revenge on them...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106100853/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_47/products_id/1009248]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
俊介是一名白领。有一天，他因火车上猥亵罪被误抓。他否认了这一点，但他周围没有人证明他的清白，尤其是三个女孩。他们告诉警察他是罪魁祸首。结果，他被捕并被解雇……几天后，他在火车上偶然发现了女孩们。他生气了，决定向他们报仇……
